notes: For a Moroccan applicant with a Moroccan Baccalauréat, this programme is accessed via Études en France / Campus France (see maroc.campusfrance.org pages), not Parcoursup; applicationChannel is therefore omitted as instructed. The tuition figure of 178 EUR/year is the general public-institution rate shown on the Parcoursup fiche; the "droits d'inscription différenciés" (2 902 EUR/year for Licence) mentioned on the Campus France page are not tied to this specific programme and are not stated here. The Campus France page on French certifications states that French certification (TCF, DELF B2, DALF) is compulsory for the Études en France procedure except in cases of exemption, but this is a general procedure requirement rather than a programme-specific requirement and the evidence does not refer to this programme. Documents listed are those named in this programme's criteria grid; the page is a Parcoursup fiche aimed at Parcoursup applicants.

note.fr: Le dossier est examiné par une commission : résultats scolaires (50 %), méthodes de travail (20 %), savoir-être (15 %), motivation (10 %), engagement (5 %). Vérifiez les notes en mathématiques, français, histoire-géo, sciences économiques et sociales, ainsi que le niveau d'anglais.
note.en: Applications are reviewed by a commission: academic results (50%), working methods (20%), soft skills (15%), motivation (10%), engagement (5%). Check grades in mathematics, French, history-geography, economics and social sciences, and level of English.

evidence.quote: Résultats scolaires 50 % Méthodes de travail 20 % Savoir-être 15 % Motivation 10 % Engagement et activités 5 %

note.fr: Un niveau d'anglais est attendu : notes d'anglais très importantes (3 sur 4) et connaissance suffisante dans deux langues vivantes dont l'anglais.
note.en: A level of English is expected: English grades are very important (3 out of 4) and sufficient knowledge in two living languages including English.

evidence.quote: Avoir une connaissance suffisante dans deux langues vivantes dont l’anglais permettant de progresser pendant la formation
